alerts.rule: A Finding becomes an Alert when its risk score crosses the configured alert threshold.

relationships.finding_to_evidence: Every Finding must reference one or more evidence_ids.
relationships.timeline_event_to_evidence: Every TimelineEvent must reference an evidence_id.
relationships.alert_to_finding: Every Alert must reference a Finding.
relationships.correlation: Correlation may link multiple TimelineEvents from the same or different machines.

error_handling.detection_rule_error: Log the rule error and continue evaluating other rules.
error_handling.invalid_timestamp: Flag the event and exclude it from ordered timeline output.
